comparisonNote: Compares externally observable behavior only: provider request message sequences, provider-visible tool calls/results, agent lifecycle events, queue update events, steering/follow-up counts, response ordering, cancellation/abort outcome, tool result/error projection, session entries and active branch state, persisted results, MCP side effects, and settlement. The system/context entry position relative to the first user prompt is a session-format detail compared as counted presence (system xN) rather than exact position. MCP calls are compared as a sorted set because concurrent tool dispatch order is scheduler-dependent. assistant is_error is projected from the explicit pisharp.isError flag (Pi records provider failure via stopReason, not assistant isError).

cases.justification: The queue_update event is emitted when the queue changes relative to the assistant tool-call event. Pi emits the assistant toolCall before the queue_update for a steer queued while the tool round is in flight; PiSharp emits the queue_update first. The settled session, provider request sequences, tool results, and side effects are identical.

cases.justification: For a provider error after partial content, Pi records the failed assistant with stopReason=error; PiSharp MAF runtime completes the stream with the partial content (stopReason=stop) so the persisted assistant has no error stop reason. The settled session content, provider request sequences, and side effects are identical.
